caption: The tag team of Johnny Starr and Chris Bradford, who beat Luster and Andre Eian two falls to one at Shock & Awe in April 2003.

name: C.O.C.K.S.

tenures.source: The fed's own forum pages, which bill the members as the team.

caption: A stable Shawn Hart announced he was reforming at the first pay-per-view in May 2003, with his bodyguard Tiny; Diablo, who had just beaten Chris McMillan, joined Hart in beating McMillan down, and the three celebrated Hart's win over Richard Gideon at Rage in the Cage in June.

name: New Age Revolution

caption: A stable Rat Fink led, billed by the ring announcer as "the New Age Revolution" at Ghoulish Games, Turkey Day Terror and Merrython; Satan's Clause, Fink Bot and The American fought on its side.

name: L.O.V.E.

tenures.source: The fed's own forum pages, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/wfw-worlds-finest-2003/archive/wfw-vox-part-deux-war-games-2004-04-01.html).

caption: The stable Anarky announced as the Liars, Oppressors and Violence Experiment after he, Jared Wells, Psycho and Felix Red won the War Games at Vox Hiberionacum Part Deux; Krist Blue stood beside Felix Red in its colors and quit it in a voicemail in June 2004.

name: The Inner Circle

caption: The stable of Maelstrom, Dan Ryan, Christian Sands and their manager Lindsay Troy, which arrived by limousine at Fenway Park on 20 September 2004 after a teasing video at Cherry Blossom Chaos II and signed with Chris Wink through their attorney Alaina Troy.

name: The Cameron Cruise Project

tenures.source: The fed's own forum pages, which bill the members as the team (first /promotions/wfw-worlds-finest-2003/archive/wfw-ghoulish-games-manson-copycat-michaels-vs-anarky-wells-psycho-main-event-read-2004-12-25.html, the Ghoulish Games broadcast's closing card run-down, to the Christmas Card broadcast).
"Unleashed (2004)" (31 May 2004) and "Russian Roulette (2005)" (12 March 2005, defending as part of a tag turmoil match)

caption: The tag team of Cameron Cruise and Joey Melton, whom Vic Waters calls the best tag team in wrestling; Melton was tricked into a ten-show contract on the night Cruise debuted at Ghoulish Games, and the team was booked into the three-way tag at Christmas Card.
